title: Add phase-based product-design engine
goal: Replace the implementation-first frontend workflow with routed design phases, durable contracts, and a DTCG-compatible token scaffold.
notes: Merged through PR #2. External design skills remain externally installed; local skills define routing and contracts.

title: Streamline README product-design narrative
goal: Make the public README accurately and concisely explain the merged phase router, design authority, token architecture, and evidence loop.
notes: Merged through PR #3.

title: Add controlled daily self-improvement loop
goal: Create a portable evidence-gated research loop that discovers ecosystem changes and proposes verified harness improvements without unsafe self-modification.
notes: Merged through PR #4. Daily Codex automation created separately; adoption and merge remain human-gated.

title: Preserve product-design resource links and notes
goal: Add a durable catalog containing the supplied design skill links, commands, phase routing, usage guidance, rationale, and assessments.
notes: Merged through PR #5. Canonical MotionSites source remains intentionally unverified rather than guessed.

title: Add deterministic project profile engine
goal: Resolve active capabilities from a machine-readable project manifest and provide non-destructive doctor and change-preview workflows.
notes: Merged through PR #6. Version one never installs or removes resources automatically.

title: Add launch-readiness foundation
goal: Make the starter easier to adopt and objectively verifiable through open-source governance, profile tests, guided initialization, generated design-token outputs, and executable evidence contracts.
notes: Merged through PR #7. Showcase application remains a separate follow-up so it can be reviewed as a real product outcome.

title: Build Agent Mission Control showcase
goal: Prove the harness through a distinctive, responsive AI-agent operations product with understandable execution state, human approval, interruption, recovery, durable artifacts, and independent running-product evidence.
notes: Merged through PR #8 with CI, policy, interaction, responsive, and accessibility gates passing.

title: Add guided project initializer
goal: Make profile selection obvious and reversible through plain-language guidance, safe presets, explicit active/inactive capability plans, and external setup guidance.
notes: Merged through PR #9. Selection remains manifest-only and inactive resources are not routed or required.

title: Add task execution launcher
goal: Turn task-ledger entries into reviewed branch or worktree plans with dependency, profile, ownership, agent-routing, and verification gates.
notes: Merged through PR #10. The launcher prepares workspaces only; it never implements, installs, merges, deploys, or bypasses explicit confirmation.

title: Prepare v0.1.0 release and launch package
goal: Turn the verified starter into a reproducible, human-gated public release candidate with clean-checkout validation, curated documentation, reviewed artifacts, and launch-ready material.
notes: Merged through PR #11 and published as v0.1.0 from commit 991c70c. The validated archive and checksum are attached to the public release.

title: Add launch metadata and social preview
goal: Make shared repository links immediately communicate the product through accurate GitHub metadata and a distinctive, legible social-preview asset.
notes: Merged through PR #12; PR #13 recorded the final handoff after the repository metadata and social preview were applied. The generated source uses the GitHub-recommended 1280x640 social-card format.

title: Add real workflow GIFs to the README
goal: Let visitors understand the starter by watching each important capability actually run beside the section that explains it.
notes: Merged through PR #14. Five focused GIFs show the real initializer, task planner, Signalroom approval/pause/resume flow, required UI states, and full verification beside the relevant README sections.

title: Record daily ecosystem research beginning 2026-07-26
goal: Deduplicate and persist material primary-source changes without adopting unreviewed runtime, security, dependency, or protocol behavior.
notes: Merged through PR #15. The research remains evidence-gated: no settings, dependencies, MCPs, permissions, or production behavior were changed.

title: Add adaptive design intake and mode-aware theming
goal: Collect product-specific visual constraints, compare realistic directions, require human approval, and make approved redesigns safe through mode-aware tokens and automated evidence.
notes: Merged through PR #16 with CI, PR policy, and Showcase checks passing. Human approval remains mandatory before canonical design-system or token adoption; external design tools remain optional inputs.

title: Document Claude Code 2.1.221 security controls
goal: Correct version-sensitive subagent guidance and record new credential masking and permission hardening without silently changing runtime policy.
notes: Merged through PR #17 with CI and PR policy passing. Documentation only: no credentials, credential paths, sandbox settings, network policy, dependencies, plugins, or MCPs were added or enabled.

title: Reconcile merged tasks and enforce final task state
goal: Correct stale merged-task records and prevent non-draft pull requests from passing policy before their linked task is prepared as done.
notes: The new policy is local and deterministic. Draft PRs remain collaborative; task status is enforced only after a PR leaves draft state.

title: Record agent runtime security releases from 2026-08-05
goal: Document material Claude Code and Codex security-boundary changes without silently changing runtimes, models, permissions, hooks, or remote-control behavior.
notes: Documentation only. The proposal records Claude Code 2.1.222 and Codex 0.146.1; it does not install, upgrade, select, enable, or configure either runtime or any model, permission, hook, credential, or remote-control capability.

title: Document Claude Code 2.1.223 security fixes
goal: Record material shell permission, approval-dialog, workflow-sandbox, and managed-policy fixes without silently changing runtime or permission configuration.
notes: Documentation only. The proposal records Claude Code 2.1.223; it does not install, upgrade, enable, or configure the runtime, agent modes, permissions, workflows, hooks, managed settings, or credentials.

title: Add Showcase visual-regression gate
goal: Turn approved UI states into deterministic pull-request checks with same-environment baselines and inspectable failure evidence.
notes: Baselines are generated and compared on the same Ubuntu CI environment. Updating a baseline creates a review artifact; it never approves visual changes or bypasses a separate evaluator.

title: Add native Codex adapter
goal: Make Codex a first-class, policy-preserving runtime with shared skills, trusted project configuration, safety-hook wiring, plugin metadata, parallel-worktree guidance, and deterministic compatibility checks.
notes: The adapter must not select models/providers, add credentials or MCP execution, enable network access, widen sandboxes, or bypass approvals. Plugin publication and runtime upgrades remain human decisions.

title: Add safe Codex specialist roles
goal: Translate read-heavy enterprise responsibilities into native project-scoped Codex custom agents without replacing worktree isolation or expanding runtime authority.
notes: All committed custom agents are read-only and authority-neutral. Write-heavy parallel work continues to require exclusive task ownership and separate branches/worktrees. No runtime upgrade, model choice, provider, MCP server, credential, network rule, or approval policy is included.
